svg.text: CARTHAGE, spring 146 BC — plate 3 of 4: THE FULL STREET GRID
Plate 2 plus the 272 lanes the quarters cut for themselves. Every carriageway in Carthage is on this sheet; the blocks between them are where housing goes. Still no housing.
